dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient observed between the primary light-toned skin and the darker longitudinal midline feature.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast, dark-grey longitudinal linear mark is centered on the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent longitudinal mark or linear scar along the spinal axis.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a dark, elliptical orifice at the anterior terminus of the dorsal plane.
